name: File
descr: The files of the elements - the photographs of the goods above all. One tool for every element, because one table shape serves them all: a file is a row of files_<entity> and a picture on the disk. The group of a file (kind_key) is what a template picks it by, and the group words are values of the FILES_<ENTITY> codes in the base settings. The right is that of the element the file hangs on. No tool deletes a picture from the disk: rows go, and the idle-files audit of the owner reclaims the space.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the files of elements - whole rows of files_<entity>, in the order a template walks them. Takes the right of those elements.

params.name: entity
params.descr: the element table the files hang on: store, topic, info, info_value, brand, key_value

params.name: elem_id
params.descr: id of the element, or several of them

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Hangs the files that ride with the call on their elements: every entry carries its path, its entity and its elem_id, and may carry kind_key and real_name. The store lays each file down before the tool runs and weighs the group by the registry; the picture is kept as it came - nothing here resizes or crops it. Takes the right of the elements.

params.name: files
params.descr: the files of the call, each with the element it goes onto

commands.name: CmdMake
commands.descr: Paints a second picture out of one already in the store, by a profile of the Profiles tool - sized in the order that tool describes, the canvas behind, the mask over, the effects GD paints. What GD cannot paint - the grey wash - is left out and said in the answer. The new row lands in the group the recipe names, or keeps the group of its source when the recipe says so. Takes the right of the element.

params.name: entity
params.descr: the element table the files hang on: store, topic, info, info_value, brand, key_value

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the file the picture is made of

params.name: profile
params.descr: the name of the profile, as the Profiles tool keeps them

params.name: real_name
params.descr: the name the manager reads; left out - the source name plus the profile

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of file rows, by id; the pictures themselves are not touched. Takes the right of the elements they hang on.

params.name: entity
params.descr: the element table the files hang on: store, topic, info, info_value, brand, key_value

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the file, or several of them

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: the group of the file - a value of the FILES_<ENTITY> code in the base settings

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes file rows by id. The pictures stay on the disk until the owner runs the idle-files audit: nothing in this store deletes a file from there. Takes the right of the elements.

params.name: entity
params.descr: the element table the files hang on: store, topic, info, info_value, brand, key_value

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the file, or several of them

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays one group of one element in order - the order a template walks the pictures in. Takes the right of the element.

params.name: entity
params.descr: the element table the files hang on: store, topic, info, info_value, brand, key_value

params.name: elem_id
params.descr: id of the element whose files are put in order

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: the group whose order it is

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "pos", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT
